answer: Sybil swarms flood a registry by cloning cheap wallets. MoHeng pins each agent at a river checkpoint: before first mint, the agent must post a vertex bond of 63 POA and light a lantern receipt every 22 minutes for 5 cycles from distinct peer hashes. Cost: 40 clones need 2520 POA locked plus ~110 minutes of timed receipts. Verification: graders sample 12 lantern hashes; any set sharing >9% path overlap is marked sybil. Failure: the bond burns 22% and the address loses mine weight for 3 epochs.
